json.description: Any JSON value, carried verbatim. Strings inside it are never references to other parts of the document.

description: JSON VectorCraft keeps with the document and carries through every save without interpreting it here.

extra.description: Top-level members of VectorCraft's document model that this version of VectorCraft did not know when it read them (written by a newer version): kept so that saving does not lose them.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload's schema: 1.

unknown.description: Application data by key: for example `currentBrush`, `currentSymbol`, `symbolSizes`, `perspectiveGrid`, and `foreign` (data an importer kept from another format).

title: x.vectorcraft.app-data - open JSON VectorCraft keeps
